pptx_deck.schema_validation: passed - pptx skill scripts/office/validate.py: All validations PASSED
pptx_deck.rendered: scripts/render_deck.sh: empties the output directory, converts with LibreOffice, then asserts the PDF is newer than the .pptx. A stale render is rejected rather than inspected - LibreOffice's headless conversion fails silently often enough that an old PDF survives and looks like a valid inspection of a deck that has since changed, which happened once during this audit.
visual_defects_found_and_fixed: slide 5: the bar chart rendered as nothing at all. Root cause: pptxgenjs v4 renamed its chart constants to upper case, so pres.charts.bar was undefined and addChart() emitted axes with no bar group - schema-valid, semantically empty, invisible. Fixed by using pres.charts.BAR. validate.py passed both before and after, so only looking at the render caught it.
slides 11-12 (Architecture, Q&A) were missing from the PPTX entirely: the JS builder never wrote them, so the PPTX had 10 slides while the HTML deck had 12.
